notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms catalogue supports the record (county, elevation, standing). Do not confuse this with the Virginia Jones Knob in Wythe County (cached at eastern_us_lookouts/jones-knob.html, a different tower) or with a North Carolina Jones Knob that searches returned. The Frozen Head tower in Morgan County is a different tower (catalogue MGT002) and is not used. No history for this tower was found in two searches or in the cached register pages.
